# Fix a failing test

**If HarnessTest failed too, start there.** It tests the suite's own machinery on a page of its
own, with no site involved: when it fails, the harness is broken (evidence, a check, an action),
and every other failure in the run is suspect until it is fixed. Rebuilding the suite
(`suite build <project>`) puts the harness back as generated.

Start with the evidence the framework saved for it: `target/failures/<TestClass>/<test>/`. The
run's output names the folder (rerunning only this test moves the full run's folders to
`target/failures-previous/`). `steps.txt` has the steps (the failed one marked), the error, and
the URL and title at that moment; `screenshot.png` and `page.html` show what the page was;
`console.txt` and `network.txt` show script errors and failed requests (often the real cause: a
menu that never opened because a script failed); `trace.zip`, opened at
https://trace.playwright.dev, replays every step with the page before and after it. Only a run's
first 10 failures keep a trace and a full-page screenshot (they are most of the weight); a later
one says so in `LIGHT.txt`: rerun that test alone for all of it (`-DfullEvidence=50` keeps more).

The output says the step it failed at, and why:

```
   3. Click "Careers" in the "About us" menu
   FAILED at step 3: Click "Careers" in the "About us" menu
   because: CareersPage did not load! URL was https://.../jobs, expected /careers
```

Then decide whose problem it is:

| The failure says | Most likely | Do |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `... did not load! URL was X, expected Y` | the site moved the page, or the link | check KNOWN-ISSUES.md; ask the user if the move is intended |
| `note: X is the right page ..., but had not finished loading after 30 s; still loading: ...` (not a failure) | a slow part of the page: another site's frame, a video, an image | the page passed; the note names what held it back. Report it if it matters; `-DpageLoadTimeout` sets how long a test waits for it |
| `... did not load! Title was ...` | the site changed its titles | regenerate, or update `TITLE` via a new crawl |
| `... did not load! X_HEADING was not visible` | the page changed, or loads it late | save the page; compare with crawl/playwright-playground.com.crawl.json |
| `Expected the X to be shown, but it was not` | a broken locator, or the site changed | save the page (use-a-saved-page.md) and fix the locator |
| `the X matches 2 elements on the page; its locator must match one` | a locator that finds several things (Playwright refuses to guess) | add `.first()`, or narrow the locator to the one meant |
| `the X's locator is not valid` (Playwright), `The locator ... is not valid` (Selenium) | a typo in the XPath or CSS: a missing bracket or quote | fix it, and check it with suite locate against the page as crawled |
| a timeout on a click | something covers it (a pop-up), or it is in a closed menu | frames-tabs-and-dialogs.md |

A generated locator is outside YOURS blocks: don't edit it. Fix it by regenerating from a new crawl,
or, until then, add a corrected constant in the elements block and use that one. Something the
site does wrong goes in KNOWN-ISSUES.md; the test stays as it is.
